headline: Escalating US-Iran Conflict Triggers Global Energy Price Surge and Gulf Infrastructure Damage.
summary: Recent US military actions against Iran have resulted in significant damage to critical energy facilities in the Gulf and an immediate surge in global energy prices, exacerbating inflation and market fragility. This ongoing geopolitical instability poses a severe and sustained threat to global supply chain logistics, manufacturing costs, and broad economic stability, with infrastructure recovery projected to take months.
